# Index, Template, and Sources-and-Basis Formats

Standard formats for the recurring meta-files VisualForge generates. Every subskill conforms.

## `00-index.md` (regenerated each run)

The canonical file map at `docs/design-system/00-index.md`. Regenerated by the orchestrator at the end of every run.

```markdown
# Design System — Index

Last regenerated: [YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM TZ]
VisualForge mode: [greenfield | specforge-enhanced | retrofit | combinations]
Total decisions: [N]
Total tokens: [N]
Total components: [N]
Total screens: [N]
Total personas: [N (primary) + N (secondary) + 1 anti + N (edge-case) + N (pair)]

## Quick navigation

- **Start here:** [RULES.md](./RULES.md) — design system rules for future contributors.
- **Foundations:** [01-foundations/](./01-foundations/) — design brief, audit, trends, personas.
- **Visual language:** [02-visual-language/](./02-visual-language/) — brand, tokens, surfaces, icons.
- **Structure:** [03-structure/](./03-structure/) — IA, layout, mobile/responsive, i18n.
- **Interaction:** [04-interaction/](./04-interaction/) — flows, content, motion, dataviz, auth, system, notifications.
- **Components:** [05-components/](./05-components/) — primitives, composites, patterns, domain.
- **Screens:** [06-screens/](./06-screens/) — one file per screen.
- **Quality:** [07-quality/](./07-quality/) — accessibility, frontend contract, ops, QA, pressure test.

## Full file map

[Tree rendering of every file produced this run, with one-line description per file.]
```

## `_index.md` files

One-page summary of the directory's contents. Used in `personas/`, `05-components/`, `06-screens/`.

### `01-foundations/personas/_index.md`

```markdown
# Personas

## Set composition

- Primary: [N] — [list]
- Secondary: [N] — [list]
- Anti-persona: 1 — [name]
- Edge-case: [N] — [list]
- Pair scenarios: [N] — [list]

## Persona summary table

| Name | Type | Audience share | Device profile | A11y profile | Primary task |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Alex | Primary | ~35% | MacBook + iPhone | Typical | Project management |
| Jordan | Primary | ~25% | Windows + Android | Color vision difference | Account management |
| Sam | Secondary | ~15% | iPad + Pencil | Typical | Quick review |
| (Anti) Casey | Anti | n/a | n/a | n/a | Wants spreadsheet flexibility we won't build |
| Pat | Edge-case | ~5% | Phone only, sporadic | Low literacy | Re-onboarding after 6mo absence |
| Alex × Jordan | Pair | ~30% of pairings | (per file) | (per file) | Manager–employee weekly review |

## Aggregate sections

### Device and input matrix
[table]

### Accessibility constraint summary
[derived constraints feeding later subskills]

### Mental model and language map
[shared vocabulary aggregated across personas]

[stacked breakdown with source basis]
```

## `Sources and basis` section (every doc)

Every generated design doc ends with a Sources-and-basis section. Standard format:

```markdown
## Sources and basis

### Source labels used in this document
- User-confirmed: [count]
- Specforge-derived: [count]
- Repo-derived: [count]
- Research-backed: [count]
- Standard-backed: [count]
- Assumption: [count]

### Research entries cited
- [RES-NNN] [topic] — see auditability/research-ledger.md

### User answers referenced
- [Question]: [short summary of answer]
- ...

### Standards referenced
- WCAG 2.2 — [criteria IDs]
- [other standards with version + section]

### Assumptions made
- [Assumption ID] [description] — risk impact: [low/med/high] — verification: [how to confirm]
- ...

### Cross-doc dependencies
- This doc consumes decisions from: [DEC-IDs from earlier subskills]
- This doc produces decisions consumed by: [DEC-IDs in later subskills]
```

## Decision-log entry template

Already in `opinionated-decision-template.md`. Every subskill writes entries to `auditability/decision-log.md` in that format.

## Research-ledger entry template

Already in `design-research-rules.md`. Every research pass writes entries to `auditability/research-ledger.md` in that format.

## Anti-slop on indexes and templates

- An `_index.md` that lacks the standard summary table fails consistency.
- A doc without `Sources and basis` fails the anti-slop rubric.
- A `00-index.md` not regenerated after the run is stale.
